original-classic-ui.json.scope:
Extract original PlotChars/display-list UI data, controlled hardware VCOUNT=16.
No interrupt timing or Atari OS ROM font parity is asserted.
original-classic-ui.json.fontSource: original-palette-hudfont.json: Altirra replacement, not original E000 font parity

original-hud.json.scope:
Original running HUD routines and glyph screen-code fixtures, offline only.
Uses MainMemory's explicit OS/GTIA bus aliases. No raster or firmware runtime.
original-hud.json.colorSemantics: ANTIC2: foreground PF2 hue | PF1 luminance; background PF2. HUD precedes DLI $0F67 setting PF1=$88.
original-hud.json.font: original-palette-hudfont.json Altirra replacement; no original E000 font parity

original-palette-hudfont.json.label: Altirra 5200 compatible character bitmaps; replacement font, not original Atari OS ROM
limitations: Replacement glyph data; no byte comparison to original Atari800 E000 ROM font. Extracted declarative glyph bitmap data only; no executable firmware.

original-palette-pal.json.license: GPL-2.0-or-later Atari800 palette generation; numerical output only
limitations: Uncalibrated against a physical Atari PAL/TV; no composite line filtering; PAL/NTSC identity of supplied image not established.
Component data only; no RGB/raster or continuous animation validation.
